agent.problem: Verse 27 says that the priests will present 'your' offerings and then God will accept 'you,' meaning the people addressed. The card removes the people from the setup and gives the right answer as 'He will accept them,' so 'them' most naturally points to the priests or the offerings. This obscures whom God says He will accept; the card should identify the people and preserve them as the object of His acceptance.
